about: Song ladder (PLAN 8.3), Levels 1-3. A song is done at 100% speed with 80% or more of the keys right the first time (wait mode, the whole song, the hands in 'hands'). A level is done when all its songs are done. Each skill moment stops the song at 'at_beat' and the song goes on from 'resume_beat' (PLAN 8.2). Titles use plain words: the user sees them before the unlock.

levels.title: First songs
levels.text: Use your right hand. Your hand stays in one place most of the time.

levels.title: Play with the click
levels.text: Play at a steady speed. The app can play the left hand for you.

levels.title: The left hand joins
levels.text: Play with your left hand. Then play with both hands. Thin lines across the notes help you count.
